name: Google Calendar
description: Your Google Calendar as a day strip and a today timeline, with invitations to answer (Accept / Maybe / Decline), tomorrow and upcoming events, and reminders with a sound you choose and a Join click for Meet. One account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it); the Jira issue beside an event that names one. Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.4 or later; 0.9.5 for reminder sounds and Join.
author: BronOS
